title: Fluffynoelle Official Minecraft Server Modpack
description: Modpack for the Fluffynoelle Official Minecraft Server
body: This is the modpack for the Fluffynoelle Official Minecraft Server (FNOMCS) made by VHSCrow. The pack includes fun and grindy tech mods such as GregTech, Create, and Mekanism, as well as other cool mods that add new world generations and structures! This pack also includes one of my personal favorite mods, being Figura, which gives you customization of the player model to the full extent.
